body.x: Choice Technology participated in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its image pointer X-Pointer.

The other laser pointers cannot be used on an LCD monitor because the light of the pointer is not visible. Choice Technology's Image Pointer was created to solve this problem. Rather than reflecting the pointer from outside the monitor like a conventional pointer, it creates an image of the pointer on the computer's screen, so it can be used on any screen, including LCDs. In addition, it is a product that can express its own personality by setting the desired image as a pointing image.

Choice Technology's image pointer supports the function of the laser pointer on all screens without installing a separate program. The same functions as regular mouse, such as drag-and-drop and double click, can be performed in the presenter's standing space. You can also increase your audience's attention with a variety of features, such as magnifying glasses, line drawing and page searches.

The premium model X-Pointer is the 'hybrid pointer' that supports both image pointer mode and premium green laser mode. This product is a rechargeable product that can be used continuously for about 30 minutes with fast charging for just 1 minute, and can be used for up to 5 hours for general presentations.
X-Pointer has firmly established the numberone position in the Korean wireless presenter market, and has sold globally tothe US, Germany, Japan, Australia, Russia and East Asia.

The official said, “In January 2020, we will be launching a premium image pointers through Japanese office companies, and in February, we will be officially launching our products in the Japanese crowdfunding Makuake. In the US market, promotions are planned through CES in January and crowdfunding Indiegogo in March. We are seeking to find US distributors. As the world's first presenter manufacturer, we are launching new products and expanding our product range to smart medical devices using wireless sensor technology.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years.
